name: Lauren Reeder
excerpt: Fortune (6 Sep 2022) names Lauren Reeder as a Dorm Room Fund alum and a partner at Sequoia Capital. Penn's M&T page (4 Aug 2025) identifies her as M&T '16 and a partner on Sequoia's early-stage team. A DRF graduation note places her on the Philly team after the M&T program.

name: Talia Goldberg
excerpt: Dorm Room Fund's recruiting page lists Talia Goldberg under Hear From Our Alumni as Partner, Bessemer Venture Partners. Fortune (6 Sep 2022) names her among DRF alums at Bessemer. Bessemer's team page lists Talia Goldberg. Campus and DRF years were not stated on these pages.

name: Alex Immerman

name: Jeremy Navarro

name: Shawn Xu
